10. Payment-Failure and Retry Policy
Payment failures can occur because of insufficient funds, bank restrictions, expired cards, authentication failures,
provider outages, incorrect billing information, or risk controls.
10.1 Retry Sequence
For eligible online card payments, Nimbus Commerce may allow: 1. the original authorization attempt, 2. a
customer-initiated retry, 3. a second automated retry where supported, 4. a payment-method change, 5. order
cancellation if payment remains incomplete.
A failed payment does not necessarily mean that an order was created successfully.
10.2 Temporary Authorization
Customers may see a temporary bank authorization even when an order fails. Such an authorization may
disappear automatically according to the bank’s release process. Support should not promise an exact bank
release time unless the payment provider has confirmed one.
10.3 Duplicate Charges
If a customer reports two charges, support must check the payment records and order IDs. Two bank entries do
not automatically mean two completed charges; one may be a temporary authorization.
If two successful captures exist for one order without a corresponding second order, the case must be escalated
to Payments.
10.4 Payment Retry Limits
Repeated payment failures can trigger a security review. Customers should not be advised to repeatedly retry a
transaction indefinitely. If multiple payment methods fail, the agent should recommend verifying billing details
and using another supported method.
